# CobaltumORM

> A .NET / C# ORM for hand-written SQL. The build parses the SQL, checks it against the schema that
> the migrations produce, and generates the executing C#. PostgreSQL is the primary target; MySQL,
> SQLite, SQL Server, and Oracle are also supported.

Start with the quick reference. It states which API to use in each situation and which rules the
build enforces. The recipes give one compiled example per task, and the diagnostics page lists every
`COB` code the build can report. Each page has an English and a Japanese version with the same
content.

The SQL checks run during compilation, so `dotnet build` is the verification step for any change to
a query, a migration, a result type, or the provider setting.

## AI documentation

- [Quick reference (English)](https://github.com/hckaye/CobaltumORM/blob/main/docs/ai/quick-reference.md): API choice, build-enforced rules, generated names, providers, verification
- [Quick reference (Japanese)](https://github.com/hckaye/CobaltumORM/blob/main/docs/ai/quick-reference.ja.md): 日本語版のクイックリファレンス
- [Task recipes (English)](https://github.com/hckaye/CobaltumORM/blob/main/docs/ai/recipes.md): one compiled example per task, from migrations to unchecked SQL
- [Task recipes (Japanese)](https://github.com/hckaye/CobaltumORM/blob/main/docs/ai/recipes.ja.md): 日本語版のタスク別レシピ
- [Build diagnostics (English)](https://github.com/hckaye/CobaltumORM/blob/main/docs/ai/diagnostics.md): every COB code with its cause and fix
- [Build diagnostics (Japanese)](https://github.com/hckaye/CobaltumORM/blob/main/docs/ai/diagnostics.ja.md): 日本語版のビルド診断一覧
